messages:
maria: Quick thread  we need a compact format for the July webinar workshop breakout. Goal: make it action-oriented and reproducible for attendees. Options: short hands-on lab vs. full demo. Thoughts?
alex: Hands-on lab is highest value. People love a repo they can clone and run. Keep main session 30m and workshop 30m.
nina: I can distill a 10-minute customer vignette for the main session, then join the workshop panel.
sam: Creative can produce a 15s promo clip and a one-slide checklist for attendees (tools + prep). Need speaker bios and headshots by 7/5.
lee: Ops note: record the intro and sample run locally; studio slot available 7/20 or 7/22. calendar-bot: Tentative slot added -> https://cal.example.com/event/1801239876
maria: Proposed run-of-show sketch: 
```
00:00-00:05 - Intro + goals + poll (maria)
00:05-00:20 - Key patterns: routing + caching (alex)
00:20-00:30 - Customer vignette + lessons (nina)
00:30-01:00 - Workshop: guided lab (breakout rooms)
```
Workshop plan: distribution of repo + 20-minute guided steps + 10-minute troubleshooting Q&A.
alex: Repo stub will include a minimal evaluator, a mock routing policy, and a sample dataset. I'll post by 7/2.
sam: I'll make a short "what to install" doc for attendees and a social card.
lee: Locking studio for 7/22 10:00 PT. calendar-bot: Event updated -> Wed 2026-07-22 10:00 PT
maria: Action items: Alex -> repo + demo stub; Nina -> 75-word blurb + takeaways; Sam -> promo clip + install checklist; Lee -> final registration + breakout setup. Please drop assets into the shared doc by 7/8.
alex: Noted, posting repo stub by Fri.
